shared_elements: low-relief carving on a pale stone slab
horizontal band/line dividing the surface into registers
a row of small repeated motifs running across a band
a crouching/seated figure with bent limbs
justification: Both are pale stone slabs carved in low relief where a principal figural scene sits above a horizontal dividing line, beneath or beside which runs a band of small repeated motifs, and both include profile figures with a crouching, bent-limbed body among them. The manner differs sharply, however: A is boldly modelled, deeply cut and dominated by animals and abstract heads on an irregular pillar, whereas B is a shallow, thin-lined, tidily framed rounded-top tablet showing two seated human figures with vessels and neat script-like rows.
